BA–MA Archaeology Pathways

A 90-minute career session, online or at your venue

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

In this session you compare degree types, course content and skills development.

It can be booked by one person or by a class. A short form before the session lets the mentor prepare for you.

What it covers

  • Degree pathways
  • University selection
  • Portfolio

How the time is spent

  1. Degree pathways 22 min

    Ancient history, AIHC&A, archaeology, anthropology.

    You: compare syllabi

  2. University selection 45 min

    Credit/entry eligibility, internships, research.

    You: shortlist choices

  3. Portfolio 23 min

    Research note and volunteer experience.

    You: admission checklist

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Diagnose participant goals and constraints based on a pre-session questionnaire.
  • Compare degree types, course content and skills development.
  • Leave with personalised recommendations and follow-up actions linked to verified sources.

You take away

A personal action plan with dates and checked sources.
